title: IBM System/360 functional ALD page, version 4
description: Human-readable functional ALD page records. Closed objects prevent accidental format sprawl; uncertainty and detailed review evidence live in a linked external JSON file.
$comment: This schema checks structure, not source truth or publication readiness. Semantic checks must enforce ascending unique block serials, unique net IDs, valid terminal and bend references, exactly-one-net membership, output-origin naming, orthogonal routes, auxiliary non-driving roles and external review hash/evidence integrity. Defaults document omission rules; JSON Schema does not insert them. Other proposed page-type values do not imply non-ALD layout support.

note.description: Footer note lines; group origin normalizes to column 4.

page.description: Printed page identifier, for example AP001.

version.description: Printed page version. Omit the default 000.

page-type.description: Original proposal page categories. This schema defines the functional ALD records; an enum value does not imply converter support for another document layout.

title.description: Printed title lines, in order. Empty when no title is established.

date.description: Printed page date, normally MM-DD-YY; null retains an unresolved reading externally.

ibm division.description: Printed letters after IBM CORP.; do not expand or infer their meaning.

num.description: Printed revision number; a string preserves leading zeroes.

status.description: Brief review status. Detailed findings belong in the external review file.

approved.description: Human approval status. Conversion alone must leave this false.

unresolved discrepancies.description: True while unresolved source, transcription or conversion discrepancies remain.

details.description: Relative link to an external, content-hash-bound review JSON file, normally review/<page prefix>/<page>.json.

offset.description: Signed [column, row] displacement in character cells.

point.description: Zero-based [column, row] on the 245 by 103 character page.

net number.description: Ordinary ID: driving page + block serial + output-line reference (AP011BJ5). The printed suffix 0 is legitimate and denotes output row 10, as in WA641AA0; it is not terminal line zero. Local exception: page + lowest-serial driven block + L + its first attached input line + -strap, -unused, -gnd, -+3v or -no-source. Terminal line numbers remain one-based. Choosing the correct anchor requires semantic validation.

node.description: Existing terminal or page-port reference. Membership must be checked against this page.

serial.description: Block serial used by references. A damaged printed serial remains an external uncertainty over the retained opaque ID.

grid position.description: Printed block grid position, such as 1C. Page character coordinates are independently zero-based.

function offset.description: Horizontal character displacement of the function. Omit zero.

circuit.description: Circuit identifier. Unresolved source text stays in the external review.

socket.description: Full socket location, including the frame prefix; omit when not applicable.

board.description: Board location for a block with no card/socket, such as the approved wired OR/DOT case.

height.description: Block height in character rows. Omit the standard height 6.

annotation.description: Printed annotation above the block unless annotation offset says otherwise.

side.description: Drawn side, not a signal direction. Ordinary left contacts are inputs and right contacts outputs; K/aux contacts are nondirectional output modifiers.

line.description: One-based line within the block, counting its top border as line 1.

pin.description: Printed physical pin number. Omit if no number is printed; null means an unresolved printed identity with evidence in external review. Net annotations are separate.

edge.description: Border mark: wedge, E, K or X. K/aux is not a signal input, output or net driver.

real net number.description: Underlying reference for indirect input, only when different from net number.

sinks.description: Destination page labels in printed order. One sink is inline; multiple sinks hang below the wire.

hanging wire length.description: First-column horizontal hanging lead length. Omit 1; zero is valid. Applies to multiple sinks.

nodes.description: Each page port and block terminal belongs to exactly one net; check this across all net records.

routing.description: Polylines of endpoints and bends only. Segments must be orthogonal. Corners, crossings and junction diamonds are inferred from same-net connectivity; crossing different nets must not join them.

connectors.description: Printed connector entries, owned by this net and in printed order. Preserve unresolved/opaque location text without guessing an identity. Table layout normalizes to row 94.

at.description: Use a terminal reference where possible, otherwise a point of this net's routing.

offset.description: Displacement from the referenced bend; terminal label side determines the ordinary pin annotation placement.

text.description: Printed annotation, including a star or other modifier; never part of the physical pin identity.

route point.description: Zero-based indices into the containing net's routing. The referenced point must exist.

column deviation.description: Explicit departure from the ordinary printed column layout; omit when not needed.
